'''Rike's Raiders''' was a unit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]], led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Amos Rike]]. In [[3629 BBY]], Rike's Raiders, opposing the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s dominance over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Assault on Denova|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]] but were eventually defeated by the efforts of [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the Alliance.<ref name="TRN" />
